QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Ellinel Fairy Academy
QuestInfo.0:
Cootie the Really Small, Grendel the Really Old's star pupil, has been charged with the kidnapping of a fairy and imprisoned at the Ellinel Fairy Academy. It's up to you to find the missing fairies and rescue Cootie, before this ruins human-fairy relations forever!\n\n

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 30-40 \r\n
- #eRoute#n \r\n
   1) Accept the quest, '[Theme Dungeon] Ellinel Fairy Academy' \r\n
   2) North Ellinia: Walk from the Giant Tree\r\n
- #eFinal Reward#n\r\n
